title: 2013 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement:
At the \(2013\) Winnebago County Fair a vendor is offering a “fair special” on sandals. If you buy one pair of sandals at the regular price of \(\$50,\) you get a second pair at a \(40 \%\) discount, and a third pair at half the regular price.

Javier took advantage of the “fair special” to buy three pairs of sandals. What percentage of the \(\$150\) regular price did he save?

solutions.text:
Javier saved \(0.40 \cdot 50 = 20\) dollars on the second pair. He also saved \(\frac{50}{2} = 25\) dollars on the third pair. This shows that he saved a total of \(45\) dollars.

As \[\frac{45}{150} = \frac{3}{10} = 0.30,\] we can conclude that Javier saved \(30 \%\) compared to the regular price.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Compute the price paid for each pair of sandals.
Compare the total savings with the regular total of \(\$150\).
